A '''scenter''' was a machine that made an artificial smell or odor in an area.

The [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] [[Watto/Legends|Watto]] used one in [[Wald's Parts|his shop]] to remake the scent of the lakes of [[Toydaria/Legends|his homeworld]].
